## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npx supabase db reset` (database changes only)

## Evidence

Add screenshots for UI changes and describe manual smoke tests.

## Change checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or production-only values are included.
- [ ] Migrations, configuration changes, and deployment steps are called out.
